meta.name: one-click-resume
meta.description: One-click resume applier for crypto exchange dev positions. Use when applying to crypto exchange jobs, submitting developer resumes to exchanges, or when the user mentions applying to Binance, Coinbase, OKX, Bybit, Gate, KuCoin, MEXC, HTX, Bitget, Kraken, Crypto.com, or any other crypto exchange careers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 投递简历到加密货币交易所
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在海投加密货币交易所的开发岗位
copy.tagline_en: Apply to crypto exchange jobs with one click
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a developer applying to multiple crypto exchange roles

howto.what: 当你说出简历路径并选定交易所后，Claude 会把简历转成文本，打开交易所招聘页面，自动填入姓名、邮箱、电话、LinkedIn 等字段，并上传简历；填好后请你检查，由你手动点提交，它不会替你提交。
howto.when: 当你想申请加密货币交易所的开发职位，提到 Binance、Coinbase、OKX 等交易所名称，或要求投递简历到交易所招聘页时。

say.text: 用这份简历投 OKX 和 Bybit 的工程师职位
say.note: 会依次处理两家交易所，最终由你手动提交。

say.text: 申请 Coinbase 的软件工程师岗位，简历是 cv.pdf
say.note: 自动填表并提醒你检查姓名邮箱和简历。

howto.what_en: Given a resume PDF and chosen exchanges, Claude converts the resume to text, opens each careers page, auto-fills name/email/phone/LinkedIn and uploads the PDF. It never submits; you click submit.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to apply to crypto exchange dev jobs, mention exchanges like Binance, Coinbase, OKX, or request submitting your resume to an exchange careers page.

say_en.text: I want to apply for a backend dev role at Binance, resume at /tmp/resume.pdf
say_en.note: Claude reads the resume and opens Binance careers.

say_en.text: Use this resume to apply to OKX and Bybit engineer positions
say_en.note: Processes exchanges one by one; you submit manually.

say_en.text: Apply to Coinbase software engineer with cv.pdf
say_en.note: Fills the form and asks you to review before submitting.
